title: Multi-sensory Materiality – Expanding Human Experience and Material Potentials with Advanced HoloLens Technologies and Emotion Sensing Wearables

findings.antecedent: Interaction with the multi-sensory augmented reality installation
findings.consequent: Heart rates change in different ways and are highly situational
findings.mechanism: Heart rate changes are observed to be highly dependent on the specific context of interaction.
findings.quote: our heart rates change in different ways and can be highly situational.

findings.antecedent: UpMood wearable technologies for experience monitoring
findings.consequent: Stable peaks, highs, and lows in experience are crucial to accuracy; variance differs person to person
findings.mechanism: Individual physiological responses and their stability/variability impact the accuracy of wearable technology data.
findings.quote: stable peaks, highs and lows, in experience are crucial to accuracy and variance from person to person can differ.

findings.antecedent: Interaction with the multi-sensory augmented reality installation
findings.consequent: Discrepancies between users' self-reported feelings and technology-indicated feelings
findings.mechanism: Differences between conscious self-perception of emotion and physiological data captured by technology.
findings.quote: discrepancies between what the users “thought" they were feeling, and what the technology actually indicated.

findings.consequent: Offered a unique perspective on how a particular user felt interacting with the project
findings.mechanism: Despite limitations, the devices provided insights into individual emotional responses during interaction.
findings.quote: the data collection devices... offered a unique perspective to the way that a particular user felt as they interacted with the project.

findings.antecedent: Stronger sensorial experiences (through research and design)
findings.consequent: Increased awareness, perceptibility, and new design conversations
findings.mechanism: Engaging multiple senses deeply leads to enhanced cognitive processing and facilitates new conceptual understanding.
findings.quote: stronger sensorial experiences can be used to increase awareness, perceptibility, and create new design conversations.

stimuli.description: A wall surface (6.5 meters long, 1.8 meters high) laser-cut into 32 sheets of flat paper material, mixed with different densities of salt, covered with crystallization coatings, and combined with layers of different colors to create varied textures and light interactions.

Augmented reality overlays via Microsoft HoloLens headset and iPhone app, displaying a full-scale hologram in a physical art space. The AR expanded on the physical installation by growing, changing densities, colors, and increasing the size and scale of patterns.
Crystallizing sound effects, edited through www.sodaphonic.com, creating rigid, striking soundtracks.
Olfactory stimulation (smell of salt) combined with sound, texture, white color, and AR.

limitations: The data collection devices (wearables) were not as sensitive as desired.
